lines.beaver_en: There's a lot of protest news lately.
lines.learner: 네, 어제도 광장에서 큰 데모가 있었어요.
lines.en: Yes, there was a big demonstration in the square yesterday too.
lines.roman: ne, eojedo gwangjangeseo keun demoga isseosseoyo.

lines.en: I heard college students led it this time.

lines.beaver_en: How do politicians react to that?

lines.learner: 네, 크게 두 편으로 나뉘어서 싸워요.
lines.en: Yes, they're split into two main sides and fight.
lines.roman: ne, keuge du pyeoneuro nanwieoseo ssawoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Could you give me an example?
lines.learner: 한국 국회가 정당 싸움의 좋은 예예요.
lines.en: Korea's National Assembly is a good example of party fights.
lines.roman: hanguk gukoega jeongdang ssaumui joeun yeyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is it the same with diplomatic issues?
lines.en: Yes, opinions differ a lot on diplomacy too.

lines.beaver_en: Then how do they protect the national interest?
lines.en: By having proper exchanges with other countries.

lines.beaver: 정치와 선거에 대해 더 말해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about politics and elections?
lines.beaver_roman: jeongchiwa seongeoe daehae deo malhae jullaeyo?
lines.learner: 작년 선거는 시민의 힘을 보여 주는 좋은 예예요.
lines.en: Last year's election is a good example of citizens' power.
lines.roman: jangnyeon seongeoneun siminui himeul boyeo juneun joeun yeyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did the protests affect the election?
lines.learner: 네, 그 시위 이후로 투표하는 사람이 늘었어요.
lines.en: Yes, more people have voted since those protests.
lines.roman: ne, geu siwi ihuro tupyohaneun sarami neureosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 덕분에 많이 배웠어요. 다음에 또 얘기해요.
lines.beaver_en: I learned a lot, thanks. Let's talk again.
lines.beaver_roman: deokbune mani baewosseoyo. daeume tto yaegihaeyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 국익을 위한 정치가 늘면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: Sure. I hope we see more politics for the national interest.
lines.roman: joayo. gugigeul wihan jeongchiga neulmyeon jokesseoyo.
